{
  "name": "tamirs-superpowers-guard",
  "displayName": "Tamir's Superpowers Guard",
  "version": "5.0.1",
  "description": "In-process guard for tamirs-superpowers: holds a destructive shell command (force push, rm -rf, git reset --hard, ...) until you answer Proceed or Cancel, and refuses a file write in the main checkout while an orchestration objective is active. Companion to the core plugin; Claude Code and Claude Desktop only.",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Tamircohen28/tamirs-superpowers",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Tamircohen28/tamirs-superpowers",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/Tamircohen28/tamirs-superpowers/blob/master/docs/engineering/architecture/guard-plugin.md",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/Tamircohen28/tamirs-superpowers/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/Tamircohen28/tamirs-superpowers/blob/master/PRIVACY.md",
  "author": {
    "name": "Tamir Cohen",
    "url": "https://github.com/Tamircohen28"
  },
  "keywords": [
    "hooks",
    "guard",
    "safety",
    "developer-tools",
    "claude-code",
    "worktree"
  ],
  "license": "MIT",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "hold_destructive_commands": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Hold destructive shell commands until you answer",
      "description": "On by default. A Bash call that force-pushes, deletes a branch with -D, removes a worktree with --force, resets --hard, cleans with -f, runs rm -rf outside a temp directory, or discards the working tree (git checkout -- . / git restore .) pauses in a Proceed/Cancel dialog before it runs. Cancel refuses the call with the guard's reason. Where nothing can draw the dialog (claude -p, the SDK) the call goes through unheld.",
      "default": true
    },
    "deny_main_checkout_writes": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Refuse main-checkout writes while an objective is active",
      "description": "On by default. While an orchestration objective is active (SUPERPOWERS_OBJECTIVE_ID, or an objective.json with status active under .dev-files/objectives/) and the session sits in the main checkout rather than a worktree, an Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit of a file inside the repository is refused with the objective's worktrees named. Writes under .dev-files/ and inside any agent worktree pass. The in-process mirror of hooks/enforce-worktree-edits.sh, which stays canonical.",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
